question: Land-use records (in India) are maintained by the __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**land revenue department**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The land revenue department is responsible for maintaining land-use records in India.
 
• These records are crucial for the management and administration of land resources.
 
• The department ensures the accurate documentation of land ownership, usage, and categorization.
 
• Land-use records assist in planning and implementing land-related policies and schemes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Land Revenue Act:**

 
 
• The act governs the maintenance of land records and administration of land revenue in India.
 
• It provides the legal framework for the collection of land revenue and management of land resources.
 
 
 
• **Digital Land Records:**
 
 
• Many states in India are digitizing land records to improve transparency and accessibility.
 
• Digital land records help in reducing disputes and frauds related to land ownership.
 
 
 
• **Revenue Department Functions:**
 
 
• The department handles land surveys, settlement operations, and collection of land revenue.
 
• It also deals with land reforms and redistribution of land to the landless.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Accurate Land Records:**
 
 
• Accurate records are essential for effective land management and urban planning.
 
• They play a crucial role in the implementation of agricultural policies and rural development programs.
